result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major readability/accessibility problem with the promotional banner text.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') appears in a very light color against a light mint background, resulting in insufficient contrast and making the text hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a darker color (e.g., dark green, teal, or black) that provides strong contrast against the light mint background to meet accessibility standards and improve readability.
